verdict.rationale: Pipecat lets developers swap speech services among 200+ integrated providers, usually in one line of code. It documents real-time STT behavior: time to final transcript (TTFS) and measured P99 latency per STT service. Community users confirm local Whisper STT and easy onboarding of other providers. Missing for 10: evidence of key-term/keyword boosting or per-provider STT model/language configuration, and any independent evidence of transcription accuracy.
